Water damage problems can often be solved with a single sensor that saves you a fortune in repairs, whether it's for floors or kitchen cabinets. Leak sensors have always been one of the best value-for-money products in the smart home category, and Shelly's newly launched Flood S Gen4 makes getting started even easier. Priced below US$30, Matter-certified, and ready to support Apple Home straight out of the box.

HomeKit Weekly is a column series dedicated to introducing smart home accessories, automation tips, and everything related to the Apple smart home framework.

Larger Sensing Area

Most leak sensors on the market only come with small metal probes on the bottom, requiring water to accumulate precisely at specific points to trigger an alarm. Shelly's new sensor takes a different approach, placing three large stainless steel sensing pads on the bottom. The larger contact area means faster leak detection and broader coverage—which is exactly why you'd place this sensor under your water heater or washing machine.

These sensing pads are also sensitive enough to detect pure water or low-conductivity water, such as condensation from air conditioners. These types of leaks are typically harder to notice. The Flood S Gen4 is also slim enough to slide under appliances, behind toilets, or beneath bathroom sinks—exactly where these devices are best placed.

Matter and Apple Home Support

The Flood S Gen4 is Matter-certified and supports both Wi-Fi and Zigbee, making it compatible with Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. Once added to Apple Home, automation possibilities expand significantly:

  • Immediately cut power to the washing machine or dishwasher when a leak is detected (if connected to a smart plug)
  • Trigger all smart bulbs in the home
  • Send leak alert notifications directly to your iPhone (especially useful when you're away from home)

Modes, Alerts, and Battery Life

The device has a built-in local alarm that works in sync with phone notifications, so people at home can hear the alert even if their phone is in another room. Shelly offers two operating modes—leak detection and rain detection—and three alarm settings (intense, normal, and power-saving), allowing you to balance leak detection speed with battery life. Using the included CR123A battery, it can last up to two years.

Conclusion

Priced below US$30, this is exactly the kind of accessory you'd buy three or four of without hesitation. Place one in front of the water heater, in front of the dishwasher, under the washing machine, and under the kitchen sink. Matter and Apple Home support let you receive notifications through the Home app and build Apple Home automations on this foundation. There's a lot to appreciate about this product, and I can't find any drawbacks. Trust me, buying leak sensors is the smartest investment you'll make for your smart home.

You can purchase the Shelly Flood S Gen4 directly from Amazon or the Shelly official website.
